  yarn eslint --max-warnings 0 'plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/Stepper/Stepper.tsx' (exit 1)
  239:5  error  React Hook useCallback has a missing dependency: 'steps'. Either include it or remove the dependency array  react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

Do not silence the rule with an eslint-disable comment and do not drop the dependency array. `steps` is derived from useTemplateSchema and is stable across renders, so adding it to the deps array is correct and does not introduce a render loop.

Also note the first attempt was rejected for changing lines outside its sites (it added lines after line 245): change only the sites the brief names.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "plugins/scaffolder-react/src/next/components/Stepper/Stepper.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
